'''Drive-Thru''' is the fifth storyline mission and third central storyline mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] given to [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] by his brother, deuteragonist and [[Grove Street Families]] [[Gang Leaders|leader]] [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] from his [[Sweet's House|house]] in the [[Grove Street]] cul-de-sac in [[Ganton]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

== Mission ==
Carl finds Sweet and childhood friends [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]] and [[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]] as he appears at his brother's house. Smoke suggests getting something to eat, and Carl drives them to the [[Cluckin' Bell]] in [[Willowfield]] where they order their food. Whilst they are eating their food, Ryder spots some Kilo Tray [[Ballas]] gang members in a pink [[Voodoo]] watching them and heading towards Ganton. The Ballas car turns around and performs a drive-by on Sweet's vehicle.

Carl drives after the Ballas, whilst Sweet and Ryder shoot at the car, eventually destroying it. Smoke decides to eat everybody's food instead of helping the team attack the Balla gang car. Carl drives then back to Ganton, before driving Smoke back to his home in [[Idlewood]].

== Script ==
'''(''[[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]], [[Sweet]], [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]], and Carl are all outside [[Sweet's House|Sweet's house]].'')'''

'''CJ''': (''as the other three come out'') What's happening with you, Ryder?

'''Big Smoke''': (''while exiting'') [[Respect]] has to be earned, Sweet - just like [[money]].

'''Sweet''': (''as they exit'') So what you saying? You don't respect me?

'''Big Smoke''': What I'm saying is... (''stops to face Sweet'')

'''Sweet''': Speak up, nigga! (''ready to confront Smoke'')

'''Big Smoke''': (''chucks off'') I'm hungry! (''laughs'')

'''CJ''': (''as they proceed to the car'') Oh, man! Shit... Hey, what's going on?

'''Big Smoke''': Man cannot live on bread alone. I know. I've tried that shit. Carl, you look a little thin, man. You gotta be hungry, man.

'''CJ''': Yeah, I could eat.

'''Ryder''': Man, what you fools trying to eat? What about some tacos?

'''Sweet''': Tacos? Again? Hell no.

'''Big Smoke''': Chicken, man. No discussion.

'''Ryder''': Man, I don't want no chicken...

'''(''Carl starts driving towards the [[Cluckin' Bell]] in [[Willowfield]].'')'''

'''Sweet''': Carl, you drive. Smoke looks like he's gonna pass out.

'''CJ''': (''as the four drive'') How'd [[Beverly Johnson|Moms]] get killed? We gotta talk about it.

'''Ryder''': We all gotta talk about it! They was going for Sweet!

'''Big Smoke''': How you supposed to know that? You know what people are like. Say they have love for you, but won't say a word. Too damn scared.

'''Ryder''': Some people say they saw a [[The Green Sabre (car)|green]] [[Sabre]] doing the work. Then speeding away.

'''Big Smoke''': Yeah, but people like to talk, don't they? Anyway, that's half of [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Santos]] you talkin' about.

'''Ryder''': Yeah, you right, my bad.

'''CJ''': Hey, bro?

'''Sweet''': They just sprayed the house. I ain't see shit.

'''(''Carl arrives at Cluckin' Bell and pulls up on the driveway.'')'''

'''Cluckin' Bell Employee''': Can I take your order, please?

'''Big Smoke''': Carl, what do you want? You gotta eat to keep your strength up, man.

'''CJ''': Hey, I'll take a number 9 - fat boy.

'''Ryder''': Gimme a number 9, just like his.

'''Sweet''': Let me get a number 6 with extra dip.

'''Big Smoke''': I'll have two number 9s, a number 9 large, a number 6 with extra dip, a number 7, two number 45s, (''Carl and Ryder turn to him, astounded'') one with cheese, and a large soda. (''they return to position'')

'''CJ''': Hey, sorry, bro, you know I gotta know about Moms.

'''Sweet''': I know CJ, I know. I mean I'm just trying not to think about it, is all. I mean, I didn't even know she was hit until it was all over...

'''Big Smoke''': (''collects the order'') Yeah, right, right, right, right, right. Let's eat. (''they pull up on the other end'')

'''Ryder''': Hey, don't we got beef around here? We been getting into it with these fools.

'''Big Smoke''': I can't stand cold food. unlike you, I ain't never ate from a trash can.

'''CJ''': (''laughs even as Ryder snatches his order'') Oh, shit - trash can bitch!

'''Sweet''': Pass me my food.

'''Ryder''': (''as a pink Voodoo passes by'') Hey, hey look - [[Ballas|Kilo Trays]] scoping us out!

'''Sweet''': Damn, Ryder, you're a jinx!

'''CJ''': Shit, them mother-fuckers headed to the [[Grove Street|'hood]]! (''the Voodoo turns to reverse'')

'''Sweet''': (''ducking as he pulls out his pistol'') DRIVE-BY!

'''(''Carl drives, chasing the Ballas car, whilst Sweet and Ryder shoot at the vehicle.'')'''

'''Sweet''': Hit it! Go, go, go! Hit the gas, we gotta ice these niggas!

'''Ryder''': Why you ain't blastin', Smoke?

'''Big Smoke''': I'll shoot 'em when I'm done eatin'.

'''CJ''': Quit stuffin' your motherfuckin' mouth! Let's go!

'''Big Smoke''': I ain't stuffin' it homie, I'm enjoyin' my meal. Hey, kill that asshole! Shit, this a great sandwich!

'''Ryder''': Smoke! Stop stuffin' your face and start popping them Ballas!

'''Big Smoke''': I'm just enjoying my food!

'''Sweet''': And them fools are trying to enjoy our deaths! Now, c'mon, Smoke, shoot!

'''Big Smoke''': Hey, I'm just finishing my fries! My Special!

'''Ryder''': Ahhh, shit! You got ketchup all over the seat!

'''Big Smoke''': The business at hand motherfucker, the business at hand!

'''Ryder''': But these was clean pants! CJ watch the damn road!

'''Big Smoke''': Chill motherfucker! This ain't a Sunday drive situation!

'''Ryder''': My soda, its all over the fuckin' floor!

'''Sweet''': Well you can suck it up once we're done! Now keep your eyes on the Ballas car!

'''(''Finally, Carl, Sweet and Ryder kill the Ballas.'')'''

'''Ryder''': Man! That was some serious shit!

'''Sweet''': Yeah, those Balla fools won't try that again! Carl, let's get back to the Grove.

'''CJ''': Alright, I'm on it!

'''Big Smoke''': Man, that food filled the hole!

'''Ryder''': You chubby motherfucker! Next time you better start blasting or I will blast you myself!

'''Sweet''': Smoke, you're wide, man, I mean wiide!

'''Big Smoke''': Yeah, and that's why you love me, baby!

'''(''Carl drives back to Grove Street.'')'''

'''Big Smoke''': That's one up for the Grove!

'''Ryder''': Say what, Smoke? All you managed to do was eat my damn food up!

'''Big Smoke''': Yeah, it was gettin' cold!

'''Sweet''': Y'all comin' in for a beer?

'''Big Smoke''': Nah baby, I need to get back to the [[Big Smoke's House|crib]]. CJ, gimme a ride?

'''CJ''': Alright Smoke, let's go. See y'all later.

'''(''Carl drives Big Smoke back to his home in [[Idlewood]] after Ryder and Sweet exit.'')'''

'''CJ''': What was with you back there, Smoke?

'''Big Smoke''': Man, if you can eat your food, while everybody else is losing theirs, and blaming you, you straight, homie!

'''CJ''': What?

'''Big Smoke''': Nothing, nothing, just some poetry I read.

'''CJ''': Ae, Smoke, tell me why you moved out of the Grove!

'''Big Smoke''': Man, I (just) got some money from my aunt. I mean, this a nice place and all, but the Grove is in my heart, baby, it's where my dogs is at.

'''CJ''': Yeah, okay, homie!

'''(''They arrive at Smoke's house in Idlewood.'')'''

'''Big Smoke''': Hey thanks, Carl. Hey, I've missed having you around, baby.

'''CJ''': Thanks, man. I wish Sweet thought like that.

'''Big Smoke''': He don't mean it, CJ. He's still real tor' up about your Moms, man. Here, get yourself a little smokey smoke on Smoke, and relax, homie. (''leaves'')

== Reward ==
The rewards for completing the mission are [[Money|$]]200 and an increase in [[respect]]. The mission [[Nines and AKs]] is unlocked. The [[Gyms]] across the [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|state of San Andreas]] are available for use after receiving the [[Mobile Phone|phone]] call from Sweet.

==Big Smoke's Order==

Smoke places a huge order at [[Cluckin' Bell]] which has become a notable meme:

{{:Big Smoke's Order}}

== Post-mission Phone Call ==

'''CJ''': Yeah?

'''Sweet''': Hey, CJ, it's Sweet.

'''CJ''': Hey, whassup?

'''Sweet''': If you don't respect your body, ain't nobody gonna respect you! Looking too skinny, CJ, you need to pack on some muscle.

'''CJ''': If I wanted nagging, I'd buy a clockwork wife.

'''Sweet''': Just looking out for you, homie, it's all show and respect, you know.

'''CJ''': Yeah, I guess.

'''Sweet''': There's a gym I go to a couple of blocks away from the Grove. Go check it out and get yourself a gangster physique.

'''CJ''': I'll scope it out, later man!

== Trivia ==
* During this mission, the Ballas are seen using a pink [[Voodoo]] with tinted windows. This is odd since the Ballas do not use the Voodoo as a gang car, but instead, the Grove Street Families use the Voodoo as a gang car. The only way to make the Ballas use the Voodoo as a gang car is to modify the '''cargrp.dat''' file. The pink Voodoo was earlier seen in the mission [[Sweet & Kendl]]. This could be suggestive of the pink Voodoo bearing structual semblance with the purple colours worn by the Ballas, as well as a mockery of the Grove Street Families.
* At the end of the mission, the [[Greenwood]] will be [[Special Vehicles|fireproof]].
* Sometimes, the Voodoo will crash into a [[Police Car|police car]] and will get stuck there, thus giving the player time to kill the gangsters.
* Carl, Smoke, Ryder and Sweet order [[Cluckin' Bell]] food, but later Smoke gets [[Burger Shot]] food.
* Sometimes you can see Smoke in a T-pose in the beginning of the cutscene where he, Ryder, Sweet and Carl are ordering food.
* This is the only time in San Andreas that the drive-thru section at a fast food joint is used.
* This mission is one of the first instances of [[The Green Sabre|Smoke's open betrayal of the Grove Street Families]]. Some even suggest that Smoke's hilariously huge order at Cluckin' Bell was actually a tedious ruse to buy the Ballas in the pink Voodoo enough time to sneak into Grove Street unnoticed, although Ryder, Carl and Sweet are able to quickly spot them.
